root_cause.text: In xfs_alloc_buftarg(), when an error occurs after successfully obtaining a reference to the DAX device (stored in btp->bt_daxdev), the error path fails to call fs_put_dax() to release that reference, resulting in a resource leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `fs_put_dax(btp->bt_daxdev, mp);` to the `error_free` label of `xfs_alloc_buftarg()` in fs/xfs/xfs_buf.c. The commit message and CVE description explicitly state that the fix is to drop the DAX device reference in the error path to prevent a leak.
